# mtncloud_mos_bucket_acl (Resource)

Who may read and write a MOS bucket, as a canned ACL. Destroy sets it back to `private`. A bucket's ACL covers listing and adding objects; each object has its own (`mtncloud_mos_object_acl`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "site" {
  name = "acme-website"
}

# Anyone may list the bucket. Each object also needs a public ACL to be downloaded.
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket_acl" "site" {
  bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.name
  acl    = "public-read"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acl` (String) `private` (only the tenant), `public-read` (anyone may list the bucket), `public-read-write` (anyone may also add and delete objects: rarely wise) or `authenticated-read` (any MOS user may list it).
- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name in MOS, usually `mtncloud_mos_bucket.<name>.name`. Changing it moves the setting to another bucket.

### Read-Only

- `grants` (List of String) The grants MOS holds, as `<grantee>:<permission>`, for example `AllUsers:READ`.
- `id` (String) The bucket's name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_mos_bucket_acl.site acme-website
```
